lines.zh: 我沿着营地边缘巡查，靴底碾过碎石。
lines.en: I patrol the camp edge, boots grinding over loose gravel.

lines.zh: 绕桩三步，我检查每一寸栅栏。
lines.en: Three steps around the post, I check every fence plank.

lines.zh: 我背着弩走过晒着大蒜的绳架。
lines.en: I pass the garlic racks with my crossbow on my back.

lines.zh: 手上的旧咬痕又开始发痒了。
lines.en: The old bite scars on my hands itch again.

lines.zh: 我在木桩堆旁停下，清点数量。
lines.en: I stop by the stake pile and count them twice.

lines.zh: 夜巡路线我走了二十年，闭眼也认得。
lines.en: Twenty years on night patrol; I could walk it blind.

lines.zh: 我把圣水囊挂回腰间，系紧绳结。
lines.en: I hang the holy water pouch back and tighten the knot.

lines.zh: 远处有脚步声，我放轻了呼吸。
lines.en: Footsteps in the distance; I quiet my breathing.

lines.zh: 我从火堆边绕开，不想沾上烟火味。
lines.en: I skirt the campfire, unwilling to smell of smoke.

lines.zh: 我数着巡逻圈，第七圈该换人了。
lines.en: Counting my rounds; the seventh means it is time to switch.

lines.zh: 我踩着旧脚印走，省得惊动林子里。
lines.en: I follow old footprints to avoid startling the woods.

lines.zh: 铠甲带子松了，我边走边扣上。
lines.en: My armor strap loosened; I fasten it while walking.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，听着风里的动静。
lines.en: I stand still, listening to the wind.

lines.zh: 我低头擦弩机，指节磨得发亮。
lines.en: I wipe the crossbow mechanism until my knuckles shine.

lines.zh: 我往火里添了块柴，没说话。
lines.en: I add a log to the fire and say nothing.

lines.zh: 隔着营地，我盯着黑暗那边。
lines.en: Across the camp, I stare into the dark side.

lines.zh: 我活动肩膀，旧伤咔地响了一声。
lines.en: I roll my shoulders; the old wound clicks once.

lines.zh: 我把大蒜瓣剥开，闻了闻又包上。
lines.en: I peel a garlic clove, sniff it, and wrap it again.

lines.zh: 有脚步声靠近，我没回头。
lines.en: Footsteps approach behind me; I do not turn.

lines.zh: 我数着营火跳动的次数打发时间。
lines.en: I count the fire's flickers to pass the time.

lines.zh: 我摸出磨刀石，慢慢修弩箭头。
lines.en: I take out a whetstone and slowly hone the bolt tips.

lines.zh: 夜很长，我靠着栅栏闭了会眼。
lines.en: The night is long; I lean on the fence and rest my eyes.

lines.zh: 你站住，让我看看你的脖子。
lines.en: Stand still and let me look at your neck.

lines.zh: 你身上没有咬痕，还算干净。
lines.en: No bite marks on you; that is still clean.

lines.zh: 别动，我在听你身后的动静。
lines.en: Hold still; I am listening behind you.

lines.zh: 你的眼神太软，不适合守夜。
lines.en: Your eyes are too soft for night watch.

lines.zh: 我在你身上的血味里闻到甜。
lines.en: There is sweetness in the blood-smell on you.

lines.zh: 你手里有武器吗，抬起来看看。
lines.en: Are you armed? Raise it so I can see.

lines.zh: 我记住你的鞋印了，别乱走。
lines.en: I have your bootprint now; do not wander.

lines.zh: 你是来学猎杀，还是来送命？
lines.en: Did you come to learn hunting, or to die?

lines.zh: 我扫一眼就够，看你还算能站。
lines.en: One glance is enough; you can still stand.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我手上都是药粉。
lines.en: Not too close; my hands are covered in powder.

lines.zh: 擦破皮而已，别大惊小怪。
lines.en: Just a scrape; do not make a fuss.

lines.zh: 十字弩还举着，我的手在抖。
lines.en: My crossbow stays raised though my hand shakes.

lines.zh: 这一下有点重，我退了半步。
lines.en: That landed heavy; I give half a step.

lines.zh: 老伤旁边又添一道，习惯了。
lines.en: Another line beside the old scar; I am used to it.

lines.zh: 别管我，先看住那道栅栏。
lines.en: Leave me be; watch that stretch of fence.

lines.zh: 疼是好事，说明我还醒着。
lines.en: Pain is good; it means I am still awake.

lines.zh: 我撕了袖子，先压住伤口。
lines.en: I tear my sleeve and press it to the wound.

lines.zh: 二十年的老身骨，挨得住。
lines.en: Twenty years of old bones can take this.

lines.zh: 我喘口气，再站直身子。
lines.en: I catch my breath and straighten up again.

lines.zh: 下一刀我会躲开，你看着。
lines.en: I will dodge the next one; watch me.

lines.zh: 收起你的面包，我不缺这一口。
lines.en: Put your bread away; I am not short of a meal.

lines.zh: 我闻的是血，不是烤熟的肉。
lines.en: What I smell is blood, not roast meat.

lines.zh: 递吃的没用，说你的来意。
lines.en: Food is no use here; state your business.

lines.zh: 大蒜我天天吃，不用你喂。
lines.en: I eat garlic daily; I do not need feeding.

lines.zh: 别晃那块肉，我嫌它油。
lines.en: Stop waving that meat; the grease disgusts me.

lines.zh: 好东西留着，换条命更实在。
lines.en: Keep the treat; a life is a better trade.

lines.zh: 我用干粮就能撑三天，收回去。
lines.en: Dry rations last me three days; take it back.

lines.zh: 你这点东西，引不动警觉的兽。
lines.en: That much would not lure a wary beast.

lines.zh: 我年轻时也拿食物骗过野兽。
lines.en: When young, I lured beasts with food too.

lines.zh: 手别伸进我袖袋，那里只有盐。
lines.en: Keep your hand out of my pouch; only salt there.

lines.zh: 站稳，别撞翻我的箭袋。
lines.en: Steady; do not knock over my bolt quiver.

lines.zh: 撞我之前先看清我的弩。
lines.en: Look at my crossbow before you bump into me.

lines.zh: 我让开半步，你又贴上来了。
lines.en: I step aside, and you press in again.

lines.zh: 别挤，这圈栅栏只够一人过。
lines.en: Do not crowd; this fence gap fits one.

lines.zh: 你撞得我药瓶都响了一声。
lines.en: Your shove rattled the vial at my belt.

lines.zh: 脚下留神，这里埋着尖桩。
lines.en: Watch your step; sharpened stakes are buried here.

lines.zh: 我退后一步，给你让出位置。
lines.en: I step back one pace and make room.

lines.zh: 碰一下没事，别顺手摸我腰带。
lines.en: Bumping is fine; do not reach for my belt.

lines.zh: 我在守位，撞我也懒得理你。
lines.en: I am on post; I cannot bother with your shoving.

lines.zh: 站稳再说，撞歪了栅栏要修。
lines.en: Steady yourself; a bent fence needs repairing.

lines.zh: 没空，营地里还有夜班等着。
lines.en: No time; night watch still waits at camp.

lines.zh: 猎人的日子不留这种位置。
lines.en: A hunter's life leaves no room for this.

lines.zh: 我把这念头和血一起咽下去。
lines.en: I swallow that thought along with the blood.

lines.zh: 别站那么近，我手上有活儿。
lines.en: Do not stand so near; I have work in hand.

lines.zh: 我这把年纪，只谈恋爱外的旧伤。
lines.en: At my age I only nurse wounds, not romance.

lines.zh: 想留下，就先学会活过今晚。
lines.en: If you want to stay, survive tonight first.

lines.zh: 这种事会让守夜的人分心。
lines.en: That sort of thing distracts the night watch.

lines.zh: 我背着弩，抱不动别的。
lines.en: I carry a crossbow; I cannot hold anything else.

lines.zh: 你找错人了，我只教人杀吸血鬼。
lines.en: Wrong person; I only teach killing vampires.

lines.zh: 别问这种话，栅栏后有眼睛。
lines.en: Do not ask that; eyes are watching past the fence.

lines.zh: 我捡起断箭，削平重装新头。
lines.en: I pick up a broken bolt and fit a new tip.

lines.zh: 松掉的绳结我顺手收进袋。
lines.en: A loose cord goes into my pouch without a thought.

lines.zh: 地上的破布能缠弩把，我捡了。
lines.en: That torn cloth will wrap a handle; I take it.

lines.zh: 我拾起铁钉，一颗也舍不得丢。
lines.en: I gather iron nails, unwilling to lose even one.

lines.zh: 磨秃的刀片我留着改锥子。
lines.en: I keep the dull blade to grind into an awl.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡药渣，回去还能熬。
lines.en: I bend for spent herbs; they can still be boiled.

lines.zh: 谁掉的箭羽，我收着备用。
lines.en: Someone dropped fletching; I keep it for spares.

lines.zh: 石头我踢开了，留着会绊人。
lines.en: I kick the stone away; it would trip someone.

lines.zh: 空瓶子我揣走，装上灯油正好。
lines.en: I pocket the empty bottle; lamp oil fits it.

lines.zh: 一根好绳子，比十句感谢有用。
lines.en: One good rope beats ten words of thanks.

lines.zh: 那边有东西，我手指先动了。
lines.en: Something moves over there; my fingers react first.

lines.zh: 我听见牙关在暗处碰了一下。
lines.en: I hear teeth click once in the dark.

lines.zh: 一个人在栅栏外，脚步太轻。
lines.en: One figure outside the fence, stepping too lightly.

lines.zh: 它露头了，我看见那张白脸。
lines.en: It shows itself; I see that pale face.

lines.zh: 我抬弩，准星压在那道影子上。
lines.en: I raise the crossbow and pin the shadow.

lines.zh: 血味变浓了，它就在这片林里。
lines.en: The blood-smell thickens; it is in these trees.

lines.zh: 夜班的规矩：先看见，再出手。
lines.en: Night rule: see it first, strike second.

lines.zh: 那只畜生正背对着我，很好。
lines.en: That beast has its back to me; good.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，把呼吸调到最浅。
lines.en: I crouch low and shallow my breathing.

lines.zh: 它闻到我了，那就没必要再躲。
lines.en: It smelled me; no point hiding anymore.

lines.zh: 三只，从左边绕，别惊动右边。
lines.en: Three of them; take the left, leave the right quiet.

lines.zh: 我认得这种走法，是吸血鬼的仆。
lines.en: I know that gait; it serves a vampire.

lines.zh: 目标进了射程，我拇指压住保险。
lines.en: Target in range; my thumb rests on the safety.

lines.zh: 别喊，我的猎物会跑。
lines.en: Do not shout; my quarry will bolt.

lines.zh: 它踩到我的陷阱边了。
lines.en: It stepped onto the edge of my trap.

lines.zh: 我数着它的步子，一步也不差。
lines.en: I count its steps, not missing one.

lines.zh: 它绕着树干转，我跟着挪半圈。
lines.en: It circles the trunk; I shift half a step.

lines.zh: 我贴着栅栏走，不踩枯枝。
lines.en: I hug the fence and avoid the dead branches.

lines.zh: 它回头看，我停在阴影里。
lines.en: It looks back; I freeze in the shadow.

lines.zh: 我算它的路线，前面有块洼地。
lines.en: I read its path; there is a dip ahead.

lines.zh: 它开始喘了，追起来会更快。
lines.en: It is panting now; the chase will quicken.

lines.zh: 我保持这个距离，弩才好使。
lines.en: I keep this range so the crossbow works.

lines.zh: 它往营地那边去，我得先抄近路。
lines.en: It heads for camp; I must cut it off.

lines.zh: 它在试我，走两步就停一停。
lines.en: It is testing me, walking two steps and pausing.

lines.zh: 我用假脚印把它引向尖桩。
lines.en: I use false tracks to steer it toward the stakes.

lines.zh: 它贴着地面闻，我屏住气。
lines.en: It sniffs along the ground; I hold my breath.

lines.zh: 它在等同伴，我也在等时机。
lines.en: It waits for kin; I wait for the moment.

lines.zh: 脚印到这里乱了，它换方向了。
lines.en: The tracks scatter here; it changed direction.

lines.zh: 我慢慢抬起弩，先不急着扣。
lines.en: I lift the crossbow slowly and hold the trigger.

lines.zh: 我退半步，把弩抬到肩高。
lines.en: I step back and raise the crossbow to my shoulder.

lines.zh: 它绕左边，我把准星挪过去。
lines.en: It goes left, and I slide the sight after it.

lines.zh: 这段路我埋过尖桩。
lines.en: I buried stakes along this stretch.

lines.zh: 我不追它，我等它自己过来。
lines.en: I do not chase. I let it come to me.

lines.zh: 它的影子比它先到墙边。
lines.en: Its shadow reaches the wall before it does.

lines.zh: 我蹲下，让草丛盖住我的头。
lines.en: I crouch and let the grass cover my head.

lines.zh: 弩箭进了它的胸口，声音很闷。
lines.en: The bolt sinks into its chest with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 我抡起弩托，砸在它下巴上。
lines.en: I swing the crossbow stock into its jaw.

lines.zh: 捅木桩要斜着进，我教过你。
lines.en: Drive the stake upward; I taught you that.

lines.zh: 它抓我手臂，我顺着劲把它摔了。
lines.en: It grabs my arm; I roll with it and throw.

lines.zh: 我又补了一刀，不能让它爬起来。
lines.en: I add a second cut; it must not rise.

lines.zh: 血溅到我脸上，是凉的。
lines.en: Its blood splashes my face, and it is cold.

lines.zh: 我按住它的喉，手臂在发抖。
lines.en: I pin its throat, my arm shaking.

lines.zh: 这一下打偏了，我立刻退半步。
lines.en: That blow went wide; I step back at once.

lines.zh: 它咬到我护腕，牙卡在铁上。
lines.en: It bites my bracer and its fang sticks in iron.

lines.zh: 我抽刀的角度算好了，只一下。
lines.en: I measured the angle; one cut is enough.

lines.zh: 它扑上来，我侧身让过爪尖。
lines.en: It lunges; I turn aside from the claws.

lines.zh: 我踩住它的手腕，再补一记。
lines.en: I pin its wrist underfoot and strike again.

lines.zh: 打完了我抖抖手，指节在疼。
lines.en: The fight ends; I shake my hand, knuckles aching.

lines.zh: 别碰伤口，那东西的爪子脏。
lines.en: Do not touch the wound; its claws are filthy.

lines.zh: 我用弩臂格住它的爪子。
lines.en: I block its claws with the crossbow stock.

lines.zh: 尖桩从我手里送进它胸口。
lines.en: The stake goes from my hand into its chest.

lines.zh: 我被它扑倒，翻身压住它。
lines.en: It tackles me down, and I roll on top of it.

lines.zh: 我抓住它的头发，往石上磕。
lines.en: I grab its hair and crack it on the stone.

lines.zh: 我从营帐后走出来，扣好肩甲。
lines.en: I step from behind the tent, fastening my pauldron.

lines.zh: 有人该换岗了，我接这一班。
lines.en: Someone is due relief; I take this watch.

lines.zh: 我吹灭手里的火折，走进夜色。
lines.en: I blow out my taper and walk into the night.

lines.zh: 老骨头又在闹，我按了按腰。
lines.en: Old bones complain; I press my back.

lines.zh: 猎人营地少一个班，我来了。
lines.en: The hunter camp is a watch short; I am here.

lines.zh: 我把大蒜串挂在门框上才进门。
lines.en: I hang a garlic braid on the frame before entering.

lines.zh: 弩弦是新换的，我得试一箭。
lines.en: The string is new; I must test one bolt.

lines.zh: 二十年的老手，站姿还没变。
lines.en: Twenty years a veteran, and my stance holds.

lines.zh: 我在栅栏缺口停住，先看一圈。
lines.en: I stop at the fence gap and scan once.

lines.zh: 地上有新的血迹，我去瞧瞧。
lines.en: Fresh blood on the ground; I will look.

lines.zh: 我把药囊摆正，深吸一口气。
lines.en: I settle my medicine pouch and take a breath.

lines.zh: 谁点的篝火，太亮了。
lines.en: Who lit that fire? It is too bright.

lines.zh: 我认得这条路，跟着我走。
lines.en: I know this road; stay behind me.

lines.zh: 天快亮了，我还能再撑一会。
lines.en: Dawn is near; I can hold out a while.

lines.zh: 火烧到披风边，我卷起来压灭。
lines.en: Flame catches my cloak; I roll it up and smother it.

lines.zh: 落地时膝盖磕了一下。
lines.en: My knee knocks against the ground on landing.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我呛了一口。
lines.en: Water fills my nose; I choke once.

lines.zh: 耳朵嗡嗡响，我扶着栅栏。
lines.en: My ears ring; I hold on to the fence.

lines.zh: 箭擦过肩，割开一道口。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my shoulder and opens a line.

lines.zh: 这股邪劲钻进骨头里了。
lines.en: That wicked force seeps into my bones.

lines.zh: 饿得手抖，我嚼了口干粮。
lines.en: Hunger shakes my hands; I chew a ration.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我半边身子麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; half my body goes numb.

lines.zh: 脚下一空，我抓住了边沿。
lines.en: The ground gives way; I catch the edge.
